term_of_protection: Author's life + 50 years (end of calendar year of death) for literary, dramatic, musical, artistic works; photographs, anonymous works, sound recordings, audiovisual works, broadcasts 50 years from taking/publication/making/broadcast
fair_use_exceptions: Fair dealing provisions (specific purposes and articles not confirmed) (unconfirmed)
registration_required: No (copyright is automatic on creation in a material form)
enforcement_body: Office of the Attorney General (publishes copyright guidance) (unconfirmed)
notes: Assented 19 Mar 1999; in force 1 Jul 2000. Berne member (Commons gives 9 Oct 1970), WTO since 14 Jan 1996. Moral rights, TPM and body not verified.
